job.name: ig9_cover
job.person_note: The man must be exactly the man from the attached photo (same face, short dark hair, stubble, olive overshirt over a white t-shirt).
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER in the look of a premium video-podcast thumbnail: a photorealistic frame of exactly the man from the attached photo (same face, hair, stubble, olive overshirt, cognac leather armchair, black podcast microphone on a boom arm, terracotta wall with shelves and a warm brass lamp softly blurred behind), warm cinematic light, slightly darkened at the top for text. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text: a big white condensed sans-serif title in three lines «5 ЧЕРТ» / «САМЫХ РЕДКИХ» / «ЖЕНЩИН», where «5 ЧЕРТ» is highlighted with a warm amber #F2A541 underline bar. No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no handles. High contrast, readable at small size in the profile grid.
job.style_qa: обложка-кадр с подкаста, ведущий из приложенного фото узнаваем и не искажён, микрофон на стойке, надпись «5 ЧЕРТ САМЫХ РЕДКИХ ЖЕНЩИН» без ошибок, другого текста и логотипов нет
job.meaning: обложка 9:16 Reels «5 черт самых редких женщин»
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The man waist-up in the lower 60% of the frame, slightly left of centre, looking slightly off-camera with a sincere thoughtful expression, mid-sentence. The title sits in the upper part, centred, starting about 18% below the top edge and inside the central 4:5 safe area so it is not cropped in the profile grid; the title never covers his face.
